Plasma UFO Sighting over Belarus - 2018

#ufo #ufotwitter 

Witness Statement: Video was captured 2018 in Belarus between Minsk and Soligorsk, with a iPhone X, the people in the car had no explanation for the event.

I'll explain those aren't flames, but Plasma around the UFO—an unconventional aircraft that uses an electromagnetic/plasma propulsion system. We can't determine the craft's shape, but it's either Disc-shaped or Cylindrical.

It's one of the best UFO sightings i have seen so far.

Look at the picture I'm going to post next to the video about plasma and tell me if it looks familiar.
